text: Databases store and organise information so we can find it easily. There are two main types: SQL and NoSQL. SQL databases use tables with rows and columns, while NoSQL databases store data in flexible forms like documents. To get information, we write queries, which are simple commands asking the database questions. Before building a database, we need data modeling, which means planning how the data connects. Indexes also help a lot. They work like a book's index, allowing the database to find data much faster without searching every row. Choosing the right type and structure makes applications quicker and more reliable.
